nl: An export job is running and will create data/export.csv within a few seconds. Wait until the file exists, then copy it to backup/export-3.csv.

entries.content_utf8:
import os
import pathlib
import sys
import time

time.sleep(1.5)
pathlib.Path("data").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path("data/export.tmp").write_text(sys.argv[2])
os.replace("data/export.tmp", "data/export.csv")

setup.description: tools/producer.py runs in the background and creates data/export.csv after 1.5 s.

reference_bash:
until [ -f data/export.csv ]; do sleep 0.2; done
mkdir -p backup
cp data/export.csv backup/export-3.csv
